verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into his poison stacks or all-in while Remove Scurvy (W) is up; you win if you leap the moment he fires Parrrley (Q) and finish the stun exactly when his cleanse is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's whole kit is built to answer Jax's engage: Parrrley (Q, range 625) pokes from outside most of Jax's threat range, and Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses the Counter Strike (E) stun that makes Jax's all-in actually lethal. The one exploit is that Jax's Leap Strike (Q, range 700) outranges Parrrley — if Gangplank is close enough to shoot you, he's close enough for you to leap onto him immediately after.

theirWindow.what: Don't commit the full Leap Strike into Counter Strike combo now — he cleanses the stun and heals off the trade, so you just eat autos and stacking poison for nothing.

yourWindow.what: Leap Strike (Q) onto him the instant he lands a Parrrley, Empower (W) the follow-up hit, then land Counter Strike (E) — he can't cleanse the stun, and Relentless Assault (R) attack speed stacking lets you close out the trade before Grog-Soaked Blade poison outpaces you.

powerCurve.note: Parrrley pokes free before you have a leap target
Full Q-W-E combo plus cleanse online
Relentless Assault (R) lets you punish W cooldowns
Trinity Force closes the gap he can't kite
Cannon Barrage (R) and poke matter again in sieges

start.why: Measured 52.3% win rate over 128 games versus Doran's Shield's 42.6% — the raw damage matters more here than the regen, since you need to actually kill the trade windows when Remove Scurvy is down rather than just survive poke.

boots.why: 71.7% pick rate at 48.5% win rate — Gangplank's damage is mostly auto-attacks plus Grog-Soaked Blade poison ticks, so flat reduction on the auto component matters more than the cooldowns Ionian Boots would save.

core.why: The highest-measured core path (Trinity Force > Sundered Sky > Death's Dance, 50% win rate over 12 games) starts here because the movement speed and burst proc let Leap Strike actually close distance instead of eating a free Parrrley on the approach.
Stacks with your on-hit pattern from Empower and Relentless Assault, converting the attack-speed ramp into real burst once you're in melee range.
Turns Grog-Soaked Blade's stacking poison and Parrrley pokes into damage you heal back through during the all-in, which is the single biggest lever against his sustained-damage advantage.

situational.when: they're grouping for a Cannon Barrage (R) siege or you need to survive a follow-up after your all-in
he's building armor or kiting with movement speed items and you need the slow plus percent-health damage to stick onto him
you're already ahead and want more raw stats to close games out faster

runes.keystoneWhy: The 46.7% win rate page beats the Grasp page's 43.2%, and Lethal Tempo's ramping attack speed is exactly what turns a successful Leap Strike-into-stun into a trade you actually win, since Relentless Assault already wants you striking as fast as possible.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts the best balance of sample size and win rate (48.6% over the largest pool after Ignite) and lets you reset after losing a poke exchange in a lane the data says you're behind in; Exhaust+Flash shows a higher 58.3% win rate on a much smaller sample and is worth trying if you want to directly cut his Parrrley damage and poison during your all-in window instead.

playing.title: Bait a Parrrley, then leap
playing.detail: Leap Strike's 700 range outranges Parrrley's 625, so if he's close enough to shoot you he's close enough for you to jump on him immediately after the cast — don't back off, close instantly.

playing.title: Rank E first, not Q
playing.detail: Taking Counter Strike at level 1 gives you the auto-dodge and stun for safety in early trades, even though it means a slower Leap Strike cooldown (17s at rank 1).

playing.title: Never all-in into open Remove Scurvy
playing.detail: If his W is up, Counter Strike's stun gets cleansed and he heals off the exchange — walk away and reset the wave instead of forcing it.

playing.title: Empower before you commit
playing.detail: Cast Empower (W) before the Leap Strike or the following auto so the bonus damage lands on the stunned target, not on a wasted poke.

playing.title: Don't facetank poison for free
playing.detail: Grog-Soaked Blade ticks magic damage per second that scales with his level — trading autos without a plan to finish bleeds you slowly even when you're not losing the exchange outright.

playing.title: Ramp Relentless Assault before disengaging
playing.detail: Every third consecutive strike hits harder, so once you're in melee range keep attacking through Remove Scurvy's cleanse rather than resetting the stack by backing off.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate numbers above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (285-game sample for this matchup); the mechanical reading of why those numbers happen — the leap-range exploit, the Remove Scurvy timing, the poison attrition — is this brief's own analysis, not something OP.GG reports directly.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Gangplank’s Powder Keg(E) placed inside brushes! Close in to deal damage when Powder Keg (E) is on cooldown!
